Name: Size
Description: Controls the overall scale of the 3D cellular pattern. Higher values produce larger, more widely spaced cells.

Name: Gap
Description: Sets the distance or separation between individual cells, affecting the openness and density of the pattern.

Name: Jitter X
Description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the X axis, introducing irregularity and breaking uniformity.

Name: Jitter Y
Description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the Y axis, adding variation and natural randomness.

Name: Jitter Z
Description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the Z axis, further enhancing the organic appearance of the 3D pattern.

Name: Scale X
Description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the X axis, stretching or compressing cells horizontally.

Name: Scale Y
Description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the Y axis, stretching or compressing cells vertically.

Name: Scale Z
Description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the Z axis, stretching or compressing cells in depth.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the 3D cellular pattern. Changing the seed produces different cell arrangements.

Name: Normalize Input
Description: If enabled, normalizes the input values to a standard range before applying the cellular pattern, ensuring consistent results regardless of input scale.
